blocks.orig: The area around Moshi and Arusha is known for its many coffee plantations, and you can find many lodges connected to one. These plantations make for an interesting visit, as you can see how coffee beans grow, are harvested and processed into your favourite drink of the day. Outside the harvest season, you learn all about the different types of beans, what exactly makes the delicious coffee taste and how the beans are processed. And of course, you get to taste some of the most delicious, freshly brewed kahawa.
blocks.html: Moshi and Arusha and the surrounding area are known for their many coffee plantations, and plenty of lodges are linked to one. A visit to a plantation is interesting, because you see how the coffee beans grow, how they are picked and how they are turned into your favourite drink of the day. Outside the harvest season you learn about the various kinds of beans, what gives coffee its delicious taste and how the beans are processed. And naturally you get to try some wonderful, freshly brewed kahawa.
